subject: Whose job is it? A young man's question, and a finger at the corporate sector
alt: Satish Acharya’s cartoon: at the centre, larger than the rest, stands Prime Minister Narendra Modi with a white beard and round glasses, in a brown sleeveless jacket over a cream kurta and pyjama; his left hand is behind his back and his right hand points to the right. His speech bubble reads, ‘YOU GREEDY! WHERE IS HIS JOB?’ At the right stands a man in a blue suit, white shirt and red tie, holding a brown briefcase marked ‘CORPORATE SECTOR’; he has a finger on his chin, thinking. At the lower left stands a young man in a blue shirt and jeans with a red file in his hand; he looks up at Modi, and his bubble reads, ‘WHERE'S MY JOB?’ The background is white with grey shadows below. Satish Acharya’s signature is at the lower right.
chutki: In the big frame the prime minister points a finger at the man from the corporate sector: ‘You greedy! Where is his job?’ Below, the young man clutching a red file asks the same question himself: ‘Where's my job?’

The needle is in the double question. The one with power asks it of the corporate sector, the corporate man stays silent, and the young man who needs the job stands between them, repeating his question with only a file in his hand.
